id: 12_Electrical Safety Inspection Electrical Inspection Checklist Electrical Safety H
title: 用电安全检查表
source_doc: course/Electrical Safety Series/12_Electrical Safety Inspection Electrical Inspection Checklist Electrical Safety H.md
author_source: project/Electrical Safety Series/12_Electrical Safety Inspection Electrical Inspection Checklist Electrical Safety H/src.py

points.K2: 表头：地点、编号、检查人、日期
points.K3: 是否打勾，写明整改措施
points.K6: 电缆：主电缆埋地或架空
points.K7: 电缆：焊接电缆离开地面
points.K8: 电缆：焊接电缆不和电线交叠
points.K13: 配电箱：保险和断路器合适
points.K17: 漏保：编号、定期试、记台账
points.K26: 设备：电动工具按规维护

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一张空白检查表，站在实验楼走廊的配电箱旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank clipboard checklist next to a closed distribution box in a university lab corridor and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲用电安全检查表怎么用。

shots.scene: 电缆、配电箱、漏电保护器、接地符号、插头五个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a cable reel, a distribution box, a residual current device, a ground symbol and a plug. No people.
shots.narration: 五大块，一项一项查。

shots.scene: 王老师带着阿杰走进实训车间，手拿空白检查表
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator leads the young male student into a university training workshop, carrying a blank checklist on a clipboard.
shots.narration: 学院用电检查，阿杰跟着王老师学。

shots.scene: 阿杰东张西望，不知从哪里看起
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks around the workshop at cables and boxes, unsure where to start.
shots.narration: 阿杰犯难：这么多线和箱，看哪儿？

shots.scene: 王老师把空白检查表递给阿杰，点了点表格
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands the blank checklist to the young male student and taps on the table rows.
shots.narration: 王老师说：照着表来，一项不漏。

shots.scene: 空白检查表特写，左列一行行空格
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of a blank checklist with rows of empty item boxes in the left column. No people.
shots.narration: 用电检查，要有一张固定的检查表。

shots.scene: 放大镜沿表格逐行往下移
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass moving down the checklist row by row. No people.
shots.narration: 照表逐项查，不凭印象。

shots.section_title: 表头：地点、编号、检查人、日期
shots.scene: 检查表顶部四个空白栏
shots.prompt_en: The top of the blank checklist showing four empty header fields. No people.
shots.narration: 表头先填好：地点、编号、检查人、日期。
overlay: 表头：地点、编号、检查人、日期

shots.section_title: 表头：地点、编号、检查人、日期
shots.scene: 王老师和老李一起在表头签名
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the facility engineer both sign in the header of the blank checklist.
shots.narration: 安全员和电工可以一起联合检查。

shots.section_title: 是否打勾，写明整改措施
shots.scene: 表格右侧的“是”“否”两列空格，一格打勾
shots.prompt_en: The right side of the checklist with two narrow blank columns, a check mark placed in one box. No people.
shots.narration: 每一项，合格勾“是”，不合格勾“否”。
overlay: 是否打勾，写明整改措施

shots.section_title: 是否打勾，写明整改措施
shots.scene: 最右一列空白栏里写上内容的图标
shots.prompt_en: The last wide column of the checklist being filled with blank lines of writing and a small calendar icon. No people.
shots.narration: 不合格的，写明谁来改、哪天改完。

shots.scene: 阿杰蹲下查看电缆外皮
shots.prompt_en: The young male student crouches down to look closely at the outer jacket of a power cable.
shots.narration: 第一块查电缆，先看外观状况。

shots.scene: 老李用空白绝缘测试仪测量一卷电缆
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tests a reel of cable with a blank insulation resistance tester.
shots.narration: 从别处调来的电缆，先测绝缘再用。

shots.scene: 测试仪旁有绿色对勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank tester display next to a green check mark beside the cable reel. No people.
shots.narration: 测量由持证电工来做。

shots.section_title: 电缆：主电缆埋地或架空
shots.scene: 主电缆埋在地下的剖面和架在杆上的两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a main cable buried in an underground trench cutaway, and a main cable carried overhead on poles. No people.
shots.narration: 主电缆要埋地或架空，不在地上乱拖。
overlay: 电缆：主电缆埋地或架空

shots.section_title: 电缆：焊接电缆离开地面
shots.scene: 焊接电缆挂在支架上离开地面
shots.prompt_en: A welding cable hung on stands above the floor rather than lying on it. No people.
shots.narration: 焊接电缆要架离地面。
overlay: 电缆：焊接电缆离开地面

shots.section_title: 电缆：焊接电缆离开地面
shots.scene: 焊接电缆泡在积水里的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a welding cable lying in a puddle on the floor, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别泡在水里，别被车轮压。

shots.section_title: 电缆：焊接电缆不和电线交叠
shots.scene: 焊接电缆和电源线缠在一起的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a welding cable tangled together with a power cable, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 焊接电缆和电源线，不能交叠缠绕。
overlay: 电缆：焊接电缆不和电线交叠

shots.scene: 电线拧在一起、缠胶布的接头图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two wires twisted together and wrapped with tape, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 缠胶布的乱接头，一律不允许。

shots.scene: 规范的接线盒图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a proper closed junction box with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 要接就由电工用合格接线盒。

shots.scene: 黄绿接地线一直连到配电箱的接地排
shots.prompt_en: A green and yellow ground conductor running all the way into the ground bar of a distribution box. No people.
shots.narration: 第二块查配电箱：接地线接到箱里。

shots.scene: 配电箱有防雨罩，插线板放在干燥台面上
shots.prompt_en: A distribution box with a rain hood, and a power strip resting on a dry shelf. No people.
shots.narration: 配电箱和插线板，要防雨防水。

shots.scene: 插线板泡在水池边的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power strip next to a sink with water splashing on it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别放在水池边、漏水处。

shots.scene: 配电箱出线接满、箱体发热的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a distribution box with too many outgoing cables and heat lines rising from it. No people.
shots.narration: 配电箱不能过载。

shots.section_title: 配电箱：保险和断路器合适
shots.scene: 配电箱内熔断器和断路器图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of fuses and circuit breakers inside a distribution box, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 保险和断路器，规格要合适。
overlay: 配电箱：保险和断路器合适

shots.section_title: 配电箱：保险和断路器合适
shots.scene: 用铜丝代替保险丝的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a copper wire used in place of a fuse, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能拿铜丝代替保险丝。

shots.scene: 接线盒盖板齐全、配电盘面板关好
shots.prompt_en: A junction box with its cover screwed on and a distribution panel with its front panel closed. No people.
shots.narration: 接线盒、配电盘，带电接线始终加盖。

shots.scene: 盖板丢失露出接线的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a junction box with its cover missing and live terminals exposed, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 盖板掉了，要马上报修。

shots.scene: 配电箱里几路出线都经过漏电保护器的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a distribution box where every outgoing circuit, lighting and equipment, passes through a residual current device. No people.
shots.narration: 第三块查漏保：每一路都要经过它。

shots.scene: 一根线绕过漏电保护器直接接出的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of one circuit bypassing the residual current device, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绕开漏保单独接线，不允许。

shots.scene: 漏电保护器铭牌特写，上面是空白参数格
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of a residual current device nameplate with blank rating boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 灵敏度要符合规定。

shots.scene: 灵敏的保护器被换成迟钝的大号保护器的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a sensitive protection device being swapped for a much less sensitive one, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 嫌它爱跳就换不灵敏的，不行。

shots.section_title: 漏保：编号、定期试、记台账
shots.scene: 每个漏电保护器上贴着编号标签
shots.prompt_en: Several residual current devices in a panel, each with a small blank number label. No people.
shots.narration: 每个漏保都要编号。
overlay: 漏保：编号、定期试、记台账

shots.section_title: 漏保：编号、定期试、记台账
shots.scene: 老李按试验按钮，在空白台账上记录签字
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses the test button on a protection device and records the result in a blank logbook, then signs it.
shots.narration: 定期测试，结果记台账，专人签字。

shots.scene: 电源进线处的接地极图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a ground electrode at the main power incoming point of a building. No people.
shots.narration: 第四块查接地：电源端要做好接地。

shots.scene: 老李用扳手拧紧接地线端子
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tightens a ground conductor terminal with a wrench.
shots.narration: 接地线要连续不断，接头拧紧。

shots.scene: 接地线截面的放大图标，旁边空白标签
shots.prompt_en: A magnified cross-section icon of a ground conductor next to a blank size label. No people.
shots.narration: 表上注明接地线的规格。

shots.scene: 老李用空白接地电阻测试仪测量，阿杰在表上记录
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer measures with a blank earth resistance tester while the young male student writes on the checklist.
shots.narration: 测出接地电阻，记入表格或台账。

shots.scene: 设备电源线末端是合格插头，插入插座
shots.prompt_en: An equipment power cord ending in a proper plug inserted into a socket. No people.
shots.narration: 第五块查设备：都要用插头。

shots.scene: 裸线头直接塞进插座的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of bare wire ends pushed straight into a socket, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 裸线头直接插，绝对不行。

shots.scene: 仪器金属外壳和灯具都连着接地符号
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an instrument's metal casing and a light fitting, both connected to ground symbols. No people.
shots.narration: 设备、灯具的金属外壳都要接地。

shots.scene: 焊机放在遮棚下
shots.prompt_en: A welding machine standing under a small protective shed. No people.
shots.narration: 焊机要有遮棚或罩子。

shots.scene: 大功率照明灯牢固装在支架上，远离可燃物
shots.prompt_en: A high-power work lamp firmly mounted on a stand, away from cardboard boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 大功率照明灯固定牢，远离可燃物。

shots.section_title: 设备：电动工具按规维护
shots.scene: 电动工具放在架子上，挂着空白检查标签
shots.prompt_en: Power tools stored on a shelf, each with a blank inspection tag. No people.
shots.narration: 手持电动工具，按规定检查维护。
overlay: 设备：电动工具按规维护

shots.scene: 检查表底部空白备注栏
shots.prompt_en: The blank remarks box at the bottom of the checklist. No people.
shots.narration: 表上没列的问题，写进备注。

shots.scene: 王老师在表尾签名
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator signs at the bottom of the completed checklist.
shots.narration: 查完由检查人签字。

shots.scene: 检查表交给实验室负责人老周
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands the checklist to the older man, who leads the lab.
shots.narration: 交实验室负责人，按规定报学院。

shots.scene: 检查表放进空白档案盒
shots.prompt_en: The checklist placed into a blank archive box on a shelf. No people.
shots.narration: 留一份存档，下次检查好对照。

shots.scene: 五个图标围成一圈，中间是检查表
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a circle around a blank checklist: a cable, a distribution box, a protection device, a ground symbol and a plug. No people.
shots.narration: 电缆、配电箱、漏保、接地、设备。

shots.scene: 阿杰在实验室门口看自查表，三层台阶图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student checks a blank self-inspection card by a lab door, next to an icon of three steps.
shots.narration: 实验室天天自查，学院定期检查。

shots.scene: 王老师带队检查，保卫处值班员同行
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator leads an inspection team with the security officer walking alongside.
shots.narration: 学校还会组织专项检查。

shots.scene: 配电箱前堆满纸箱的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a distribution box blocked by stacked cardboard boxes, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 配电箱前，不许堆放东西。

shots.scene: 阿杰把纸箱搬开，箱门能完全打开
shots.prompt_en: The young male student moves the boxes away so the distribution box door can open fully.
shots.narration: 留出通道，出事时能马上拉闸。

shots.scene: 电线横穿走道、有人被绊的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cable stretched across a walkway with a person pictogram tripping over it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 电线横穿走道，会绊人、被压坏。

shots.scene: 电线走在线槽里，过道处加盖线缆护板
shots.prompt_en: Cables neatly routed in a wall trunking, and a cable protector ramp covering the cable where it crosses the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 走线槽，过道加护板。

shots.scene: 检查表上不合格项被圈出，旁边日历图标
shots.prompt_en: A failed item circled in red on the checklist next to a calendar icon. No people.
shots.narration: 查出隐患，定人定时限期整改。

shots.scene: 老李修好后王老师复查，在表上打勾
shots.prompt_en: After the facility engineer fixes the problem, the safety administrator rechecks it and ticks the item.
shots.narration: 改完复查，合格再销号。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，板上是检查表和五个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard showing a blank checklist and five icons.
shots.narration: 照表检查，五大块一项不漏。

shots.scene: 是、否两列和日历图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of yes and no columns and a calendar. No people.
shots.narration: 是否勾清楚，整改写明白。

shots.scene: 持证电工证件图标和测试仪图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank electrician certificate and a blank tester. No people.
shots.narration: 测绝缘、测接地，交给持证电工。

shots.scene: 签字、存档、复查三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a signature, an archive box and a recheck tick. No people.
shots.narration: 签字存档，整改闭环。

shots.scene: 欣欣和王老师、阿杰拿着检查表向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera together with the safety administrator and the young male student holding the checklist.
shots.narration: 常查常改，用电无忧，下次见！
